Is this an additional action that the enemy wouldnt have normally gotten? I brought up troop events cause it sounded like a forced action at the end of the turn, but there is likely a similar issue as your guard skill has additional act speed and it being chosen by naturally enemy AI would result in it being used first in the turn rather than last. Does the slime act, then the party, and then the slime again in that turn?
If nothing comes to mind, next step would be disabling every plugin, testing, re-enabling them group by group and retesting to see the first point that the issue happens.
Also as an aside, you want to avoid spaces in your plugin names like "Action Fix". There are circumstances where a space (or any other forbidden HTML character) in the name of a file for RMMV may cause it to not properly be found by the game when running
